annotations.text: Proposed: sprites carry a tiny floating bar box top-right. No cards. Log kept in the centre for now. Intent chips show the action and number, not the target. Hold a unit for numbers and arrows; the eye button shows every arrow. Tap a die to lock it, hold for details. Numbers shown in tens.
Sketch here. Copy pieces from the parts bin, paste onto this board, drag. Rough is the point. Save when you want me to see it.

Vector HUD: everything that is not a sprite is a flat vector overlay. Parallelogram bars leashed to units by short diagonal lines, chamfered dice with corner brackets when locked, bracketed intent readouts, a terminal log. The colour chip above the board swaps the whole overlay between green, yellow, red and cyan.
